newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso gains, sidesteps certification worry.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso gains, sidesteps certification worry.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 0.7 to close at 1,074.3 against the dollar, shrugging of worries about the potential effect of the U.S. "certification" decision due later in the day.

Most analysts and government ministers expect the United States to blacklist Colombia for its perceived failure to crack down hard enough on drug trafficking for a second consecutive year. The real question mark hangs over whether renewed decertification will trigger economic sanctions.
Interbank dealers said markets were very quiet -- trading only about half the daily average -- because it was month end, which means banks close early to square their books.
Early in the session there was demand for greenbacks from vehicle assemblers offset by an influx of petro-dollars.
Dealers reported operations worth a total of just $79 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,073.9 before sinking back toward the close.
